# The Shadow Signal

> The Shadow Signal is a monthly deep dive into high strangeness, hosted by Stefan Gearhart and Josh Rutledge. From UFOs and cryptids to psychic phenomena and government secrets, we explore the bizarre and unexplained one jaw-dropping episode at a time.

Hosted by Stefan Gearhart and Josh Rutledge. 62 episodes, each with a full transcript, summary, timestamped highlights and topics.

- RSS feed: https://www.spreaker.com/show/6893232/episodes/feed
- All episodes: https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/
- Topics: https://theshadowsignal.com/topics/

## Episodes

- [What Really Happened in Sacramento's Vampire Case?](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/what-really-happened-in-sacramento-s-vampire-case/): The Sacramento murders of Richard Trenton Chase, the investigation that identified him, and the delusions behind the Vampire of Sacramento case.
- [400 Years of Dogmen Werewolves and Wolf Beasts](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/400-years-of-dogmen-werewolves-and-wolf-beasts/): Explore werewolf folklore, Michigan Dogman sightings, the Beast of Bray Road and other reported wolf-like creatures.
- [12 UFO Religions That Changed History (Heaven's Gate, Raëlism & Beyond)](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/12-ufo-religions-that-changed-history-heaven-s-gate-raelism-beyond/): Explore 12 UFO religions and movements, including Heaven's Gate, the Aetherius Society, Unarius, and Raëlism.
- [Cast Out — The Exorcism and Murder of the Ossett Case (1974)](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/cast-out-the-exorcism-and-murder-of-the-ossett-case-1974/): The 1974 Ossett case: Michael Taylor’s exorcism, the murder of his wife Christine, and the questions raised about mental health and religious authority.
- [Phoenix AZ 1947 - The Forgotten UFO Case](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/phoenix-az-1947-the-forgotten-ufo-case/): Explore William A. Rhodes’s 1947 Phoenix UFO photographs, the Project Grudge investigation and competing explanations.
- [Tales from Disclosure: The FBI Files](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/tales-from-disclosure-the-fbi-files/): Historical FBI UFO files, witness accounts, flying disc sightings and unanswered questions about government records.
- [Al Bender: The Man Who Knew Too Much](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/al-bender-the-man-who-knew-too-much/): Explore Albert K. Bender's UFO research, his Men in Black encounter, and his claims about non-human entities on Earth.
- [Eastern State Penitentiary: America’s Most Haunted Prison](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/eastern-state-penitentiary-americas-most-haunted-prison/): Explore Eastern State Penitentiary’s solitary confinement system, punishment methods and reported hauntings.
- [The GATE Program & The Gateway Mystery](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/the-gate-program-the-gateway-mystery/): Explore GATE, MK-Ultra, Project Stargate, and Robert Monroe’s Gateway Process, separating documented history from speculation.
- [Why She Traded Spirits for Spells: Sunshine Witchski’s Journey](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/why-she-traded-spirits-for-spells-sunshine-witchskis-journey/): Sunshine Witchski discusses sobriety, witchcraft, ritual and her work supporting people in recovery.
- [Deck the Halls with Beasts & Claws: A Cryptid Holiday Special](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/deck-the-halls-with-beasts-claws-a-cryptid-holiday-special/): Josh, Stefan, and Santosh explore Bigfoot, Mothman, and other legendary creatures in a holiday cryptid countdown.
- [Whispers at Maplecroft: Lizzie Borden’s Ghostly Requiem](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/whispers-at-maplecroft-lizzie-bordens-ghostly-requiem/): Explore Lizzie Borden’s trial, life at Maplecroft and reported hauntings at the Borden murder house and her later home.
- [Omens & Harbingers of Doom](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/omens-harbingers-of-doom/): Explore the Black Bird of Chernobyl, Mothman, banshees and other legends of omens and disaster premonitions.
- [The Man from Taured and other Travelers from Forgotten Realms](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/the-man-from-taured-and-other-travelers-from-forgotten-realms/): Explore the Man from Taured, the Green Children of Woolpit, Hollow Earth and theories about lost civilizations.
- [Foo Fighters and Fringe Phenomena of WWII](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/foo-fighters-and-fringe-phenomena-of-wwii/): Foo fighters, wartime cryptid reports, gremlin folklore and other mysteries associated with World War II.
- [Leap Castle: Irelands Fortress of Fear](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/leap-castle-irelands-fortress-of-fear/): Explore Leap Castle’s Bloody Chapel, oubliette, ghost stories and theories about the Elemental.
- [The Linda Napolitano Abduction](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/the-linda-napolitano-abduction/): Linda Napolitano’s alleged Manhattan alien abduction, Budd Hopkins’ investigation, disputed witnesses, and a Netflix defamation lawsuit.
- [The Convergence Files: Mount Shasta](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/the-convergence-files-mount-shasta/): Explore Mount Shasta’s geology, Lemurian legends, Native American traditions, reported hauntings, cryptids, and UFO sightings.
- [The Convergence Files: Superstition Mountains](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/the-convergence-files-superstition-mountains/): Explore Superstition Mountains folklore, the Lost Dutchman's gold mine, ghost stories and UFO sightings in Arizona.
- [UAP Hearing Reactions](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/uap-hearing-reactions/): Reactions to the UAP hearing, including David Grusch’s claims, pilot testimony, congressional oversight and public response.
- [Season 5 Premiere with Shane Hurd](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/season-5-premiere-with-shane-hurd/): Shane Hurd discusses MUFON’s Experiencer Resource Team, UFO investigations, cattle deaths and support for people reporting unusual experiences.
- [SEASON 4 FINALE - Dr. Lynne Kitei - Author & Producer](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/season-4-finale-dr-lynne-kitei-author-producer/): Dr. Lynne Kitei discusses her Phoenix Lights sightings, witness reports, official responses, and her research into the 1997 event.
- [The Varginha UFO Incident](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/the-varginha-ufo-incident/): Explore the 1996 Varginha UFO incident, including reported creature sightings, alleged military captures and James Fox's documentary.
- [Craig Campobasso - Talks Valiant Thor and More!](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/craig-campobasso-talks-valiant-thor-and-more/): Craig Campobasso discusses Valiant Thor, Stranger at the Pentagon, extraterrestrial species and his research into UFO hotspots.
- [MR Gorga Interview - Origin of Demons](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/mr-gorga-interview-origin-of-demons/): MR Gorga discusses demon origins, possession, cryptids and spiritual protection from a Christian perspective.
- [UFO Propulsion with Marc Dantonio](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/ufo-propulsion-with-marc-dantonio/): Marc Dantonio discusses habitable planets and speculative UFO propulsion, from warp drives to gravity and extra dimensions.
- [Russ Kellett - Author & Alien Abductee](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/russ-kellett-author-alien-abductee/): Russ Kellett discusses claimed alien abductions, an intergalactic war, UFO footage and his investigation of a 1974 incident in Wales.
- [Debz Shakti - Quantum Hypnotherapist](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/debz-shakti-quantum-hypnotherapist/): Debz Shakti discusses quantum hypnotherapy, alien contact, dreams and ley lines, and her work on Alien Abduction: Answers.
- [The Convergence Files: The Enfield Convergence](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/the-convergence-files-the-enfield-convergence/): Explore UFO sightings, humanoid encounters and other 1977 reports discussed alongside the Enfield haunting.
- [Earl Grey Anderson - MUFON UFOlogist](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/earl-grey-anderson-mufon-ufologist/): MUFON investigator Earl Grey Anderson discusses UFO research, reported alien encounters, and his mother's work for Howard Hughes.
- [Michael Schratt - Author of Dark Files](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/michael-schratt-author-of-dark-files/): Michael Schratt discusses the Dark Files, alleged UFO crash retrievals, witness accounts and the challenges of verification.
- [John Yost - Director of Alien Abduction: Answers](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/john-yost-director-of-alien-abduction-answers/): John Yost discusses his abduction experiences, his documentary Alien Abduction: Answers and his views on consciousness.
- [Luis Jimenez - Host of the Unidentified Celebrity Review](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/luis-jimenez-host-of-the-unidentified-celebrity-review/): Luis Jimenez discusses UFO evidence, witness credibility, alien contact claims, and the origins of the Unidentified Celebrity Review.
- [The Sir NoFace Trilogy](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/the-sir-noface-trilogy/): Josh and Stefan discuss Chad Calek’s Sir NoFace Trilogy, from an Australian ghost investigation to aliens and alleged men in black.
- [Kendra Star, Lycionian Spokesperson](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/kendra-star-lycionian-spokesperson/): Kendra Star discusses the Lycionians, Hollow Earth, alleged Draconian conflicts and her paranormal research.
- [Kathleen Marden Interview 2.0](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/kathleen-marden-interview-2-0/): Kathleen Marden discusses alien contact experiences, abduction research, and support for experiencers.
- [Author, Andrea Perron](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/author-andrea-perron/): Andrea Perron discusses her family's reported haunting, the Warrens' investigation, her books and a childhood UFO sighting.
- [Chris & Tyler from Doc Side Media](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/chris-tyler-from-doc-side-media/): Doc Side Media founders Chris and Tyler discuss paranormal filmmaking, Conscious Contact: Full Disclosure, UAP sightings, and telepathy.
- [Ben Eno, Co-Host of Behind The Paranormal](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/ben-eno-co-host-of-behind-the-paranormal/): Ben Eno discusses paranormal investigation, alien contact, mythology and technology, alongside a Sasquatch report and shadow figure experiences.
- [Dave Scott of Spaced Out Radio](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/dave-scott-of-spaced-out-radio/): Dave Scott of Spaced Out Radio discusses paranormal research, UFO experiences, standards of proof and the New Jersey Gator Man.
- [Jay from Project Unity](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/jay-from-project-unity/): Jay from Project Unity discusses CE5, UFO experiences, consciousness and disclosure, alongside a listener’s nighttime encounter.
- [The Pascagoula Abduction](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/the-pascagoula-abduction/): Explore the 1973 Pascagoula abduction claims, UFO sightings, skeptical objections, and a Mississippi Bigfoot report.
- [5 Contactee Cases of the 1950's](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/5-contactee-cases-of-the-1950-s/): Five 1950s UFO contactee cases, from Truman Bethurum and Elizabeth Clare to Buck Nelson, and the beliefs surrounding their encounters.
- [The Antonio Villas Boas Alien Abduction](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/the-antonio-villas-boas-alien-abduction/): Explore Antônio Villas Boas's 1957 alien abduction claim, including his reported encounter, the craft and its aftermath.
- [The Betty and Barney Hill Alien Abduction](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/the-betty-and-barney-hill-alien-abduction/): Santosh David joins a discussion of Betty and Barney Hill's alleged abduction, missing time, hypnotic regression and influence on UFO accounts.
- [Ryan Sprague, Host of Somewhere in the Skies](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/ryan-sprague-host-of-somewhere-in-the-skies/): Ryan Sprague discusses his UFO sighting, witness experiences, paranormal connections and research for Somewhere in the Skies.
- [Fae Around the World](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/fae-around-the-world/): Explore fae folklore around the world, from European banshees and changelings to Japanese tree spirits and West African beings.
- [The Phoenix Lights - 25 Years Later with Shane Hurd](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/the-phoenix-lights-25-years-later-with-shane-hurd/): Shane Hurd revisits the 1997 Phoenix Lights, the public response and his methods for investigating UFO sightings.
- [Jason Guillemette, Host of the UAP Studies Podcast](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/jason-guillemette-host-of-the-uap-studies-podcast/): Jason Guillemette shares his childhood UAP sighting and discusses UFO reporting, CE5 and paranormal research.
- [The Travis Walton Experience](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/the-travis-walton-experience/): The Travis Walton UFO abduction account, its witnesses and investigation, plus a listener’s Kentucky church encounter.
- [The Battersea Poltergeist](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/the-battersea-poltergeist/): Explore the Battersea Poltergeist, the Hitchings family’s reported haunting, and UFO sightings in England during the 1950s.
- [Dimensional Shifts with Author, Jim Schmidt](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/dimensional-shifts-with-author-jim-schmidt/): Author Jim Schmidt discusses past lives, dimensional shifts, the multiverse, and consciousness.
- [UAPx with Jeremy McGowan](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/uapx-with-jeremy-mcgowan/): Jeremy McGowan discusses UAPx research, O.S.I.R.I.S. sensors, expedition data and methods for investigating UAP sightings.
- [Author, Ryan Musgrave-Evans](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/author-ryan-musgrave-evans/): Ryan Musgrave-Evans discusses cryptoterrestrials, childhood encounters and links between paranormal phenomena.
- [The Anunnaki with Special Guest, Allen Greenfield](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/the-anunnaki-with-special-guest-allen-greenfield/): Allen Greenfield discusses Anunnaki legends and theories, while the hosts explore Mantis Man sightings and a listener’s dark humanoid encounter.
- [Andy Marcial from NY UAP Discussion](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/andy-marcial-from-ny-uap-discussion/): Andy Marcial discusses the Rubber Duck UAP footage, online skepticism and the challenges of assessing UFO videos.
- [Pioneers of the Paranormal - Robert Monroe](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/pioneers-of-the-paranormal-robert-monroe/): Explore Robert Monroe’s out-of-body experiences, Hemi-Sync technology and consciousness research, plus reported cryptid and UFO sightings.
- [Season 4 Premiere: The Rendlesham Forest Incident](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/season-4-premiere-the-rendlesham-forest-incident/): Explore the Rendlesham Forest UFO sightings, the Halt tape, Jim Penniston’s account and a listener’s unexplained experiences.
- [December Bonus Episode: Twas The Night Before Cryptidmas](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/december-bonus-episode-twas-the-night-before-cryptidmas/): The Jersey Devil recites a Cryptidmas poem featuring Nessie, Mothman, Loveland Frogs and the Pope Lick Monster.
- [December Bonus Episode: Deedra Koepp Ankrom's Encounter from the FearScape](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/december-bonus-episode-deedra-koepp-ankrom-s-encounter-from-the-fearscape/): Deedra Koepp Ankrom recounts three encounters with an unseen presence and reflects on their possible meaning.
- [December Bonus Episode: Carla Robinson's Encounter From The Fearscape](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/december-bonus-episode-carla-robinson-s-encounter-from-the-fearscape/): Carla Robinson shares an encounter involving a radiant light, a mysterious presence and a message about love.
- [Season 3 Finale - Former USAF Counterintelligence Agent, Walter Bosley](https://theshadowsignal.com/episodes/season-3-finale-former-usaf-counterintelligence-agent-walter-bosley/): Walter Bosley discusses Hollow Earth stories, pulp fiction and the secret space program; the hosts read Jenna's apparent abduction account.
